```yaml
name: ADR Agent

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  adr-agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Install Copilot CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/latest/download/copilot-linux -o /usr/local/bin/copilot
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/copilot

      - name: Run ADR Generator Agent
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # The agent persona is defined in .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
          # The Copilot CLI can run a script with the agent persona
          copilot run --agent .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
```
